decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo to quickly mill through the deck and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. It utilizes a mix of artifacts and enchantments to power up the combo, with Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble providing additional card draw and recursion to keep the combo going. The deck aims to set up the combo as quickly as possible while controlling the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. It seeks to win the game through a quick and efficient combo finish.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the synergy between Amulet of Vigor, Explore, and Primeval Titan to quickly ramp up mana and search for key lands such as Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva. By utilizing lands like Gruul Turf and Simic Growth Chamber, the deck aims to generate explosive mana turns, allowing for big plays like casting multiple Primeval Titans in a single turn. The deck also utilizes cards like Arboreal Grazer and Lotus Field to further accelerate its mana production, ultimately aiming to overwhelm the opponent with big threats.

This deck focuses on quick and aggressive gameplay by utilizing a combination of creatures and spells to deal damage to the opponent as fast as possible. The key strategy is to control the board and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Scion of Draco and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, while using efficient removal spells such as Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to clear the way. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional power boost to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain momentum throughout the game.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a mix of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It includes a variety of instant and sorcery spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating value through cards like Snapcaster Mage and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck also features powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Thundertrap Trainer to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. The mana base is optimized to ensure consistent access to both red and blue mana sources.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards that benefit from having multiple colors in play, with Tribal Flames and Leyline of the Guildpact providing powerful effects based on the number of different lands you control. The deck also includes aggressive creatures like Territorial Kavu and Bonecrusher Giant to pressure opponents, along with disruption spells like Stubborn Denial to protect your threats. Jegantha, the Wellspring acts as a powerful companion option, while cards like Xander's Lounge and Leyline Binding provide additional utility and control options to help secure victory.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a variety of creatures and spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also utilizes the Companion mechanic to enhance its strategy. By efficiently using cards like Lightning Bolt, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Tribal Flames, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a fast victory. The inclusion of Leyline of the Guildpact and Stubborn Denial provides additional control against opposing strategies, while also adding versatility to the deck's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to maintain a fast-paced and assertive playstyle to outpace the opponent.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on using a fast and aggressive strategy to overwhelm the opponent. The key concept is to quickly establish a board presence with efficient creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls, while using burn spells like Lightning Bolt to remove threats. Cards like Amped Raptor and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury further enhance the aggressiveness of the deck, while Goblin Bombardment provides additional reach. Static Prison and Blood Moon help disrupt the opponent's game plan, allowing the deck to maintain its aggressive edge and secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on assembling an aggressive board presence quickly and efficiently, utilizing cards that can quickly deal damage to the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional layer of versatility to the deck. Overall, the strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of creatures, removal spells, and burn spells to secure a victory in a fast-paced, high-pressure game.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes cards that provide additional support and flexibility, such as Leyline Binding and Stubborn Denial. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of strategy to the deck. The mana base is optimized for consistency and versatility, allowing the player to cast spells of multiple colors easily. Overall, the deck aims to bring the opponent's life total to zero as quickly as possible through a combination of creature attacks and direct damage spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing the companion Jegantha to complement an aggressive Mardu strategy. It includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and removal like Fatal Push, while also incorporating powerful creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Amped Raptor. The deck's mana base is optimized with fetch lands and shock lands, allowing for consistent color access. Additionally, cards like Goblin Bombardment and Ocelot Pride provide extra reach and finishers. The deck aims to pressure the opponent quickly and efficiently, while also disrupting their game plan with targeted removal and disruptive spells.

This Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using cards like Lightning Bolt, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Guide of Souls. The deck also includes cards like Amped Raptor and Galvanic Discharge to maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Blood Moon helps disrupt the opponent's mana base, while cards like Arena of Glory and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provide additional support for the aggressive game plan. The deck focuses on dealing damage quickly and efficiently to secure a victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a strong board presence and overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck utilizes cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls to boost the power of creatures and protect them from removal. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and flexibility. With a mix of efficient creatures, removal spells like Lightning Bolt, and lands that support the aggressive game plan, this deck aims to close out games quickly and decisively.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. It aims to control the board with cards like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog while using cards like Force of Negation and Spell Snare to stop key threats. The deck also has options for graveyard hate with cards like Cling to Dust and Consign to Memory. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's strategy, this control deck looks to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a longer game.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, while also utilizing removal spells like Fatal Push and Fell the Profane to deal with threats on the board. The deck aims to eventually overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Boggart Trawler, using Necrodominance and Soul Spike to bring them back from the graveyard if needed. The One Ring provides additional utility and card advantage, while Takenuma, Abandoned Mire and Castle Locthwain help ensure the deck has the necessary resources to dominate the game.

The deck focuses on ramping up lands quickly to cast powerful creatures and disrupt opponents with counterspells. The goal is to fill up the graveyard with creature cards and then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with a sudden surge of creatures. By using cards like Street Wraith and Shardless Agent to cycle through the deck, as well as force of negation to protect the combo, the deck aims to control the game until it can execute its game-winning combo.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures with abilities that synergize well together to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes spells to deal direct damage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By combining a mix of efficient creatures, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers, this deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and control the battlefield to secure a swift victory. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive nature of the deck by providing the necessary colors for casting spells and activating abilities.
